habitat: Scrubby areas, open bushland, thorn forests and cultivation; semi-arid scrub, thorny acacia/Prosopis thickets, open woodland edges, hedgerows; sea level to 1500 m
description: Compact shrike of semi-arid scrub, thorn forest and cultivation; hunts lizards, large insects, small birds and rodents from exposed perches and impales prey on thorns.
